banner.title: <1>Terms</1> shared across datasets
banner.sub: Place <1>terms</1> starting from a question, and link them with relations to datasets' kinds and items or to standard terms. The more relations connect, the more cross-dataset questions can be answered.
banner.fixNote: The list below is collected automatically from imported data. To rename a term, open its dataset and use “Review the design”.

map.title: Map of terms
map.lead: Your datasets' kinds and fields become one map. The more datasets connect, the more this map grows. The band at the bottom holds the world's standard vocabularies — the more relations gather there, the better your data speaks with the world.
map.bandHint: The more relations gather here, the more your terms connect with the world
map.unavailable: Couldn't draw the map right now — the datasets' ingest rules could not be read. Wait a moment and reload the page.

schemaError: Couldn't load the list of terms. Wait a moment, then press "Reload". If it keeps happening, tell whoever set this server up.

classesCard.title: Terms in use right now
classesCard.note1: The number on the right = the count. <1>Kinds count how many things of that kind exist</1>, <3>fields count how often they are used</3>.
classesCard.note2: * Only <1>published (citable) data</1> is counted. Unpublished drafts are not included — they enter the tally once published.
classesCard.emptyAll: There is no published data yet, so there are no terms yet. Publish data via "Add data" and it will appear here.

usersCard.title: Datasets using these terms
usersCard.empty: No datasets yet. Add a file from "Add data" and it will appear here.
usersCard.draftNote: Once published, its terms also appear in the list on the left.

caution.body: The terms listed here are shared by several datasets. Renaming one affects search and answers for every dataset that uses it.

known.prov: PROV-O (who made the data, and how)
known.qudt: QUDT (standard terms for quantities and units)
known.skos: SKOS (grouping terms and their alternative names)
known.cmso: CMSO (terms for crystal structure, composition and defects)

overview.toggleAria: Switch how the map is shown
overview.aria: Overview of the dataset kinds and connections
overview.lead: Each circle is a kind, sized by how many there are. The circles in the middle are the connections that tie datasets together. Switch to Detailed to see the fields.

legend.hub: Kind taking part in a connection
legend.size: Circle size = number of items (smallest to largest shown)
legend.hubDataset: Datasets that take part in a link

overview.leadDataset: Each circle is a dataset; its size is the total record count of its kinds. The circles in the middle band are the links that connect datasets. Click a circle to open just the kinds around it.
overview.leadFocus: Showing only what is around your choice, as kind circles. Use "Back to overview" to return.

title: Questions

question.titlePlaceholder: e.g. How many records are there for each sample composition?
question.hint: Terms are placed to answer this question. A term without a question cannot be created.
question.place: Place the terms the answer needs
question.empty: No questions yet. Start by writing what you want to know.

defaultCq.class: How many {{label}} are there in each dataset?
defaultCq.property: How many values of {{label}} are there in each dataset?

question.placedNote: Placed "{{label}}". If the answer needs other terms, place them next.
question.standardNote: The standard term is used as it is, so no term was created.
question.notSaved: The question you wrote here is not saved.

term.label: Term (Japanese)
term.standard_first: Look for a standard term first
term.decline: Don't use it, create a new term
term.many_isolated: {{n}} term(s) have no data answering yet. They will not appear as question candidates until a relation is decided.
term.removeBlocked: Relations still point to this term. Remove the relations first.
term.exists: A term with the same ID already exists.
term.label_ja_hint: In Japanese. This is the name shown on screen.
term.slug_hint: Lowercase ASCII letters, digits and _, starting with a letter (e.g. sample_composition). The same ID means the same term.
term.slug_invalid: The ID must be lowercase ASCII letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
term.cq_hint: Answers are counted from datasets connected by relations. With no relation yet, it reads "0 datasets".
term.std_use_note: This standard term can be used as it is, so no term is created. To decide a relation between kinds, pick this standard term in the "Decisions" section.
term.std_reason_required: Write why you are not using it (kept as a record).
term.list_empty: No terms yet. Write a question, or create one here.

lines.brokenHint: The term this relation pointed to can no longer be found.
lines.empty: No relations of this kind yet.
lines.lead: Relations decided between terms, datasets and standard terms. Filter them by kind. A relation stays as a citable fact and can be withdrawn later.
lines.datasetNone: No dataset can be matched to a standard term yet.
lines.standardLead: Match the kinds and fields a dataset made itself to widely used standard terms.
